def connected_cabinet_example() -> Component:
    """The cabinet of ``cabinet_example`` with its door and drawer connected to the
    carcass for ``TrajectoryEvaluator.fit``, which solves each joint from the film.

    Each ``connect`` names the part that moves and the part it moves against,
    with the child's frame at the pose fitted to the fitting views: the door
    opened 0.8 rad about its hinge line at (-0.21, -0.2) puts its centre at
    (-0.354, -0.061, 0.4), turned 0.8 rad about z. The door's call gives no
    priors; the drawer's says it is more likely a slide than not, along -x,
    and its opening is chosen clear of the shelf as in ``cabinet_example``.
    """
    import effectful.handlers.jax.numpy as jnp
    import numpyro.distributions as dist
    from robotl.handlers.cad.support import non_overlap
    from robotl.ops import joints, shapes
    from robotl.ops.syntax import Material, Origin, Port, Pose, choose, constrain, defcomponent

    from robotl_reconstruction.articulation import connect

    @defcomponent
    def Slab(self, size, color):
        self.shape = shapes.centered_cube(*size)
        self.material = Material(density=300.0, friction=0.5, color=jnp.array(color))
        self.base = self.place(Port())

    @defcomponent
    def Cabinet(self):
        self.base = self.place(Port())
        self._origin = joints.Weld(Origin.base, self.base)
        wall = [0.6, 0.5, 0.4, 1.0]
        for name, size, center in (
            ("back", [0.02, 0.4, 0.6], [0.19, 0.0, 0.3]),
            ("left", [0.4, 0.02, 0.6], [0.0, -0.19, 0.3]),
            ("right", [0.4, 0.02, 0.6], [0.0, 0.19, 0.3]),
            ("bottom", [0.4, 0.4, 0.02], [0.0, 0.0, 0.01]),
            ("top", [0.4, 0.4, 0.02], [0.0, 0.0, 0.59]),
            ("shelf", [0.4, 0.4, 0.02], [0.0, 0.0, 0.2]),
        ):
            piece = Slab(size, wall)
            setattr(self, name, piece)
            setattr(self, f"_{name}", joints.Weld(self.base, piece.base, Pose(pos=center)))
        self.door = Slab([0.02, 0.4, 0.4], [0.8, 0.3, 0.2, 1.0])
        self.door_joint = connect(
            self, self.door, Pose(pos=[-0.354, -0.061, 0.4], rv=[0.0, 0.0, 0.8])
        )
        self.drawer = Slab([0.36, 0.34, 0.12], [0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0])
        opening = choose(dist.TruncatedNormal(-0.15, 0.02, low=-0.3, high=0.0))
        self.drawer_joint = connect(
            self,
            self.drawer,
            Pose(pos=[opening, 0.0, 0.11]),
            kinds={"slide": 0.8, "hinge": 0.1, "weld": 0.1},
            axis=dist.ProjectedNormal(20.0 * jnp.array([-1.0, 0.0, 0.0])),
        )
        constrain(non_overlap(self.drawer, self.shelf))

    return Cabinet()

def limited_cabinet_example() -> Component:
    """The cabinet of ``cabinet_example`` with the joint limits a film shows, for
    ``TrajectoryEvaluator.fit``; the drawer's opening is fixed at its fit, -0.15.

    ``Params`` holds the limits the fitting views cannot show, each with a prior
    wide enough for what the film might show, and ``parameters(Params)`` reads
    them; unfitted, each is at its ``init``. A hinge's position is its angle, so
    the door's observed 0.8 rad lies inside its range; a slide's position is its
    displacement along its axis from ``pose``, so the drawer's observed opening
    is 0 and it closes at a negative position. Only limits may depend on
    ``Params``: a fit holds the geometry fixed.
    """
    from dataclasses import dataclass
    from typing import Annotated

    import effectful.handlers.jax.numpy as jnp
    from babyrobot.sim.model import Prior
    from robotl.ops import joints, shapes
    from robotl.ops.syntax import Material, Origin, Port, Pose, defcomponent

    from robotl_reconstruction.articulation import parameters

    @dataclass(frozen=True)
    class Params:
        door_closed: Annotated[float, Prior(low=-0.3, high=0.3, unit="rad", init=0.0)]
        door_open: Annotated[float, Prior(low=0.8, high=2.6, unit="rad", init=1.6)]
        drawer_closed: Annotated[float, Prior(low=-0.4, high=0.0, unit="m", init=-0.15)]
        drawer_open: Annotated[float, Prior(low=0.0, high=0.4, unit="m", init=0.1)]

    p = parameters(Params)

    @defcomponent
    def Slab(self, size, color):
        self.shape = shapes.centered_cube(*size)
        self.material = Material(density=300.0, friction=0.5, color=jnp.array(color))
        self.base = self.place(Port())

    @defcomponent
    def Cabinet(self):
        self.base = self.place(Port())
        self._origin = joints.Weld(Origin.base, self.base)
        wall = [0.6, 0.5, 0.4, 1.0]
        for name, size, center in (
            ("back", [0.02, 0.4, 0.6], [0.19, 0.0, 0.3]),
            ("left", [0.4, 0.02, 0.6], [0.0, -0.19, 0.3]),
            ("right", [0.4, 0.02, 0.6], [0.0, 0.19, 0.3]),
            ("bottom", [0.4, 0.4, 0.02], [0.0, 0.0, 0.01]),
            ("top", [0.4, 0.4, 0.02], [0.0, 0.0, 0.59]),
            ("shelf", [0.4, 0.4, 0.02], [0.0, 0.0, 0.2]),
        ):
            piece = Slab(size, wall)
            setattr(self, name, piece)
            setattr(self, f"_{name}", joints.Weld(self.base, piece.base, Pose(pos=center)))
        self.door_axis = self.place(Port(), Pose(pos=[-0.21, -0.2, 0.4]))
        self.door = Slab([0.02, 0.4, 0.4], [0.8, 0.3, 0.2, 1.0])
        self.door.pivot = self.door.place(Port(), Pose(pos=[0.0, -0.2, 0.0]))
        self.door_hinge = joints.Hinge(
            self.door_axis,
            self.door.pivot,
            axis=jnp.array([0.0, 0.0, 1.0]),
            theta0=0.8,
            range=(p.door_closed, p.door_open),
        )
        self.drawer_rail = self.place(Port(), Pose(pos=[0.0, 0.0, 0.11]))
        self.drawer = Slab([0.36, 0.34, 0.12], [0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0])
        self.drawer_slide = joints.Slide(
            self.drawer_rail,
            self.drawer.base,
            axis=jnp.array([-1.0, 0.0, 0.0]),
            pose=Pose(pos=[-0.15, 0.0, 0.0]),
            range=(p.drawer_closed, p.drawer_open),
        )

    return Cabinet()

def connect(
    parent: Component,
    child: Component,
    pose: Pose,
    kinds: Mapping[str, float] | None = None,
    axis: dist.Distribution | None = None,
    pivot: dist.Distribution | None = None,
) -> joints.Joint:
    """Part ``child`` moves against part ``parent``, observed with its frame at
    ``pose`` in ``parent``'s frame; a film's fit solves how.

    ``parent`` and ``child`` are ``@defcomponent`` parts, and the call is made in
    a constructor that can see both, such as ``connect(self, self.door, pose)``
    in the parent's; a typed ``Component`` subclass has no ``place`` and is not
    supported. ``pose`` only starts the solver, which solves the observed pose,
    the joint's ports, its kind, axis and limits from the film. Optional priors:
    ``kinds`` maps ``"weld"``, ``"slide"`` and ``"hinge"`` to probabilities
    summing to 1, a kind left out being ruled out; ``axis`` is a distribution over
    unit directions in ``parent``'s frame, such as
    ``numpyro.distributions.ProjectedNormal(20.0 * direction)``, whose
    concentration's norm sets how sure it is; ``pivot`` is a distribution over a
    hinge's pivot point in ``parent``'s frame, such as
    ``numpyro.distributions.Normal(point, 0.02).to_event(1)``. Without priors
    every kind and direction is equally likely.

    The call only marks the connection. Until a fit solves it, the evaluator,
    the benchmark and the agent's REPL build it under :data:`WELDED`, as a weld
    at ``pose``, so a scene with connections compiles, renders and scores as its
    welded twin.
    """
    raise NotHandled
